differences.what: How much of the method's core formula (μ_l / centring) is credited to the White-Bear Steering (Raman 2026) paper versus to a separate repo document
differences.message_quote: It's the paper's μ_l used as a steering vector: "centring, done in the forward pass instead of the readout."
differences.writeup_quote: The repo's μ program (`notes/synthesis.md`): mu_l is the counterfactual, and the uncentred mean decodes to the continuation prior — subtracting it is centring, done in the forward pass, not the readout.

rationale: Both documents credit Raman 2026 (White-Bear Steering) as the source of the layer-22/band placement idea and frame the new method as a modest companion (+0.04, 'not a rival') rather than a reproduction. However, the write-up splits credit: the μ_l/centring formula comes from the repo's own notes/synthesis.md, while only the placement (above L20-24, read-cell locality, layer 22) comes from the WBS paper; the closing message collapses this into a single claim that the μ_l formula itself is 'the paper's,' overstating the WBS paper's direct contribution to the core method relative to the write-up's own attribution.
